providers.name: Owens Community College / Kool Kat Science
providers.description: Kool Kat Science (a.k.a. Pandaia Projects) runs project-based youth STEM classes and camps through Owens' Workforce & Community Services and at partner sites. Owens' current Kids & Teens catalog lists ~33 courses, including 'Coding with Scratch Jr.' (ages 6–8) and 'AI & Machine Learning' (ages 9–12), plus robotics, 3D printing and science titles, mostly for ages 5–12 — but Owens publishes no dates or prices on the catalog listing page, so call for both. CONFIRMED for 2026–27 (Kool Kat's own site, 2026-08-17): the organization won the City of Toledo Youth Programming Grant for a third year, and is launching Future Builders Lab — a 15-week afterschool program for grades 3–6 with New Leaf Group, built from three five-week mini-courses (Rookie Makers, Rookie Coders, Rookie Robotics) plus help with STEM magnet high-school applications — in fall 2026. It also runs STEM in the Stacks at the library (see the Toledo Lucas County Public Library entry), a Micro:bit Maker Lab at Toledo Tech Loft downtown, and South City STEAM at Mosaic Family Zone on Orchard Street in the Old South End (City-sponsored 5-day camps at $20, fully refunded as a gift card for full attendance; camps include Kibble Caper Forensics and Forces of Nature for ages 6–8 and Mechanical Puppet and Rookie Robotics for ages 9–12).
